C0224.title: Prosecution Team Breaks Down Typical E-Commerce Fraud Schemes: How to Avoid the Traps
C0224.summary: A case handled by the Tongzhou District Procuratorate in Beijing reveals that unscrupulous merchants sold counterfeit baby formula at low prices on e-commerce platforms after fraudulently registering companies under others' identities or purchasing business licenses to appear legitimate. The conduct involved falsified transactions, operating under false identities, and deceiving consumers.
